{{Quote|Trandoshan proximity mine. Nasty.|[[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>}}
'''Proximity mines''' were one of the most common types of [[Mine/Legends|mines]] used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
Proximity [[Mine/Legends|mines]] deployed in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] were simple units that exploded as soon as they detected a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] within their blast range. They were the most common mine deployed into space.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Proximity mines were high-powered explosive packs with a wide explosive radius that used sensors capable of detecting shifts in air pressure to detonate the mine when anyone entered its blast zone. They could also be detonated with a timer or when a ship passed within the radius of an energy field around the mine. The only way to disarm a ground proximity mine was to crawl up to it and deactivate it. There were floating variants, which were deployed by [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Unidentified minelayer|starfighters]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==History==
[[File:ProximityMine-NEGWT.png|thumb|left|Another variant.]]
Shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] encountered these mines which were used in water by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. As part of the deal for the ''[[Prosecutor]]'', the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] brought a huge supply of the mines and planted them throughout the ship. [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] encountered many of them during the Clone Wars, as they were also used by the Trandoshans on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. These mines were additionally used by the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
